name: barbell curtsey lunge
description: A lunge where you step diagonally behind you with a barbell on your back. It works the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.
